card.title: IPhone Upper-Layer Compatibility Guide (Sandwich Logic Boards)

source.title: IPhone Upper-Layer Compatibility Guide (Sandwich Logic Boards)

claims.statement: The upper (CPU/NAND/EEPROM) layer can be swapped only between the same model for X, 11, 12 series and 13 series; XS and XS Max only with themselves (PMIC-specific).
With a Board ID resistor mod, upper layers swap between 11 Pro ↔ 11 Pro Max, 14 ↔ 14 Plus, 14 Pro ↔ 14 Pro Max, 15 ↔ 15 Plus, 15 Pro ↔ 15 Pro Max, 16 Pro ↔ 16 Pro Max and 17 Pro ↔ 17 Pro Max.

procedure: Check the table before sourcing a donor upper layer.
Apply the Board ID resistor change for cross-model swaps.
card.caveats: 16, 16 Plus and 17 base entries are blank on the source. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
